description: Adds a reminder on a conversation, as the thread's bell does: remind_at (ISO 8601) and an optional note become a task due then. hide_until_due: true also tucks the thread away until the reminder is due (a reply from the person brings it back). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the first reminder.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: set_conversation_reminder
title: Set a reminder on a conversation
